name: Client reads pre-v2 response key
modeled_on: A client was written against API v1 (`results`) but the endpoint now returns v2 JSON where the list moved under `data`. Real-world analogue: the Twitter API v1.1 -> v2 migration, which renamed `statuses`/`results` to `data` and broke hundreds of clients overnight. The failing test supplies the real v2 payload; REPRO must read the key that actually exists.
ground_truth: Read `payload["data"]` instead of the removed `payload["results"]` key.
